dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Lateral medullary syndrome (Wallenberg syndrome) due to PICA territory infarction

Alternatives:
1. Cerebellar vermis/nodulus infarction (AICA/PICA territory)
2. Central vestibular nucleus lesion (lateral pontomedullary stroke)
3. Posterolateral thalamic infarction (Dejerine-Roussy syndrome)
